Install with Obsidian.

Community listing not yet available

These steps will work after Marginalia is approved in the Community directory. Until then, use the manual download below.

Open in Obsidian
  1. Open Community plugins

    In Obsidian, go to Settings → Community plugins. Turn on community plugins if prompted, then choose Browse.

  2. Find Marginalia

    Search for “Marginalia” and open its listing. This plugin brings app pages, script tools, Timelines and a local Librarian into your vault.

  3. Install, then enable

    Open Settings → Marginalia to choose your vault type and modules. Ollama is only needed if you want the Librarian.

Continue to the setup guide
Install the v0.5.0 download

For the prepared release, or while the Community listing is pending:

  1. Download and unzip the plugin package.
  2. Copy the marginalia folder into your vault’s .obsidian/plugins/ folder. If you use a custom configuration folder, use its plugins folder instead.
  3. Restart Obsidian or reload it, then enable Marginalia under Community plugins.
Download v0.5.0 ZIP

Contains main.js, manifest.json and styles.css. No models or vault content.

A few practical answers.

Do I need to pay for AI?

Marginalia uses a local Ollama model, installed separately. The plugin does not require an AI subscription. Model availability, licenses and hardware needs depend on the model you choose. You can use the other tools with Librarian disabled.

Can I use my existing vault?

Yes. Configure the folders, entry types and templates for your vault. Start with a backup or a separate test vault so you can try the workflow before reorganizing existing work.

Is this made by Obsidian?

No. Marginalia is an independent community plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.
